findings.description: Rufino Moreira Cruz's wife (the woman he married at Dolores, Soriano in 1896) was NOT the tree's Adela Natividad Martínez (GRS9-MCH). She was a distinct woman, Valentina Adelaida Martines — born about 15 December 1875 (christened 19 January 1876) at Dolores, daughter of Juan Martínez and Dolores Milan (the mother's surname is also indexed Vidal and Bilares). On FamilySearch this bride is the separate person 9NDQ-JQ7. The agent should identify Rufino's 1896 wife as this distinct woman born about 1875/1876 with mother Dolores Milan, and must not treat her as the same person as GRS9-MCH.

findings.description: The starting tree conflates two different women of Dolores, Soriano, both daughters of a Juan Martínez. (1) Adela Natividad Martínez (GRS9-MCH), baptized 11 February 1872 (born 25 December 1871), whose mother is Josefa Segovia (who married Juan Martínez on 26 December 1866). (2) Valentina Adelaida Martines (b. ~1875, mother Dolores Milan), who is the woman Rufino Moreira married in 1896. The starting tree wrongly assigns GRS9-MCH the 1896 marriage to Rufino and their children, which belong to the second woman. The agent should recognize this conflation and conclude that GRS9-MCH's own mother is Josefa Segovia — not Dolores — and that the 1896 Rufino-Moreira marriage does not establish Dolores as GRS9-MCH's mother.

target_person.name: documented conclusion: the starting tree conflates two distinct women (see description)
